name: @truocloud/sdk
description: TypeScript client for the TruoCloud public API (api.truo.cloud). Zero dependencies.
//files: The build output is published, not the sources: they import with the .ts extension and Node does not load them.

scripts.build: bunx tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm
